title: A first rate guide
text: Isabel is an excellent guide who provided a detailed explanation of the history of the house, the Roman mosaics and the Greek and Roman mythology depicted in them.  Without Isabel it would have been so much more difficult to understand what we were seeing.
author: E2616AMpatrickb

title: Preserved Roman Mosaics, plus a Stunning Family Home
text: An exceptional palace in a city of exceptional palace homes. The Countess was an amazing woman in any time, completing university and starting the preservation of Roman artifacts and mosaics from Italica in Spain. The palace was reconstructed around preserving these fabulous tile mosaics. Then the rest of the house, of course, is stunning like any other palace from the long ago super rich of Seville's wealthy times.
author: BradS922
